summary.prose: Build native connection managers for the VS Code extension and JetBrains plugin, with separate workbench/project session owners and one common wire/state fixture corpus. Add strict protocol consumers, safe forms and recovery effects, then wire native Settings/actions and verify actual two-client UI, lifecycle, privacy and source preservation. Run only relevant tests per task; after all implementation, freeze the source and run the full Node/backend, extension and Gradle checks, preserving failures and pending release evidence. Deprecated insrc-ide work is excluded.

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: CM-S5-STATE: all list states distinct, retained root, full-key identity, filter/search/counts, add reveal and stale-view rejection
CM-S5-DIRTY: every draft exit Discard/Cancel; editing fixed identity/scope; zero effects after Cancel; unknown mutation retains reconciliation on close
CM-S5-FORM: descriptor subset validation, every offered driver, safe endpoint/secret-slot serialization and Keep/Replace/Clear; pinned/read-only compatibility
CM-S5-TEST: same draft serializer for Save/Test, optional testing, exact stale-result tuple, repeated click suppression and cancel
CM-S5-WIRE: capabilities, descriptors, safe lists/reads, tickets, outcomes/status, test/removal replies strict/size-bounded; old/missing/malformed fails closed

CM-S5-SYNC: one versioned/digested JSON wire+state/effect transcript corpus executed by TypeScript and Kotlin, divergent-field/transition negative controls; both bundles exclude daemon/storage/provider code.
CM-S5-COMPAT: old daemon/new client upgrade UI; no legacy mutation fallback, legacy unrelated projections retained, pinned family retained
CM-S5-TRANSPORT: persistent request multiplexing, disconnect pre/postwrite, timeout/abort, request ID collisions, finite buffers, exactly-once disposal and no raw error leak

CM-S5-OWNER: one owner per extension workbench or JetBrains Project;30sheartbeat,90sexpiry,sameepochresume/new epoch,root switches/close-reopen; no session end on Configurable disposal, no persistent capabilities.

CM-S5-WINDOW: two actual project-scoped services/workbench hosts, same roots/IDs and overlapping RPC IDs, forged owner hints and disposed/stale-view refusal; owner-only delivery and independent project disposal.
CM-S5-OUTCOME: known commit vs activation/refresh failure; lostreply same-ticket recovery, expiry, no changedpayload/new operation retry; row/card independent cleanup phases
CM-S5-REMOVE: exact root/scope/ID confirmation, zero-effect Cancel, busy/conflict retention, unknown status, ticket-only retry and same-ID recreation safety

CM-S5-ENTRY: VSCode Settings/command and JetBrains native Settings/AnAction route each project/workbench to the same guarded manager; explicit project chooser for application Settings, no-project/multiroot/retained-root cases.
CM-S5-UI: actual VSCode extension and JetBrains native manager in light/dark/highcontrast, labels, focus/live status and keyboard-only add/edit/test/Delete/Discard flows.
CM-S5-LIFETIME: before-add temporary copy in both clients, panelclose/root switch retention, workbench disposal/reconnect/expiry/restart loss; no inferred lifecycle success from backend snapshots
CM-S5-SOURCE: both clients supported SQL/KV/file Test/Save/discard/delete leave seeded source rows/bytes unchanged; SQL Server unavailable remains pending

CM-S5-PRIVACY: synthetic endpoint/secret/config/capability canaries absent from Settings,memento,webview state,logs,telemetry,artifacts and other-window events; temporary actions cause zero persistence
CM-S5-BUILD: fresh Node22 backend and extension typecheck/bundle; JDK21 ./gradlew test build and applicable verifyPlugin checks; packaged runtime smoke for both live clients.
CM-S5-SWEEP: per-task relevant Node/JUnit tests, then final frozen backend+explicit extension+JetBrains suites with exact logs/counts; no forced live gates or historical failure relabeling.
CM-S5-GATE: production remains fail-closed until current S001/provider/worker-affinity/SQLServer/both-client prerequisites are genuinely satisfied; test-positive evidence never enables shipped gates
